metric.note: 4-card native baseline vs 4 worker + 1 INC fused, direct wall clock per PRINCIPLES

changes_kept.what: INC forward stripes each (source, destination) pair across several AIV lanes; stripe count derived from lane budget at run time, joined on the previously unused BulkIncPrepBase control region
INC resource policy version 3: two thirds of INC lanes to Dispatch (fanout moves W times the bytes Combine returns), one third to Combine; still depends only on live_aiv
SwiGLU tile loop double-buffers loads and batches whole intermediate rows per tile instead of one row, so MTE2 overlaps the vector stage and the six PIPE_V barriers amortise
One Cube core sweeps gate_up for the whole cohort after the GMM1 join instead of all live_aic cores issuing a whole-cache DcciAll at the same instant
changes_kept.evidence: AIC checkpoints: flush 25 us -> 0.6 us, SwiGLU wait 42 us -> 17.9 us, FFN span 194 us -> 171 us

changes_reverted.why: moving the sweep before the cohort join put a full whole-cache sweep on each core's critical path; join then waits for the slowest sweep
ranged striped sweep cost 11 us and did not shrink the SwiGLU wait; worse than one whole-cache sweep
combine lanes already arrive staggered behind their own GMM2 waits, so routing the sweep through one lane only added ticket round trips

key_findings: dcci reaches a shared device point of coherency: a striped sweep in which each core flushed lines written by other cores stayed bit exact, so per-core flushing of one's own writes is not required and cohort-wide whole-cache sweeps were 23/24 redundant
cohort-wide DcciAll only costs when the cohort is released by a common barrier and every core sweeps at the same instant; where lanes arrive staggered the redundant sweeps are nearly free
INC forward per-lane bandwidth is about 3.5 GB/s, roughly half the worker's isolated single-lane rate, and aggregate across 4 links is about 55 GB/s, half of theoretical
run-to-run spread of the vLLM mean is about 0.8 ms, larger than several individual optimisations, so single runs cannot resolve sub-0.5 ms changes
